name: AEGIS by 100monkeys.ai
description: AEGIS by 100monkeys.ai, in beta, is a self-hosted orchestrator that runs autonomous agents in isolated, policy-enforced runtimes with durable FSM state. It enforces isolation and policy on every tool call, and each run is a durable state machine. Free and open source under AGPL-3.0, written in Rust; source at github.com/100monkeys-ai/aegis-orchestrator. Install: curl -fsSL https://get.100monkeys.ai | bash. We build AEGIS at 100monkeys.ai.
